description:
Single-tool async Sales Mission state machine.

    action=start: starts a mission and returns job_id quickly.
    action=status: checks the same job without starting another mission.
    action=result: fetches the final result without starting another mission.

    This intentionally keeps all async lifecycle operations inside ONE MCP tool so
    clients that expose only run_sales_mission can still complete the workflow.

action.description: Async action: start, status, or result. Use start for a new mission. Use status/result with the returned job_id.
action.title: Action

destination.description: Where to keep/send the result: alpinelead, webhook, pipedrive, hubspot, both, or all.
destination.title: Destination

goal.description: Natural-language sales objective. Required only for action=start.
goal.title: Goal

job_id.description: smj_... job ID returned by a previous start call. Required for action=status or action=result.
job_id.title: Job Id

max_budget.description: Hard cap in AlpineLead credits. The mission never intentionally exceeds this amount.
max_budget.title: Max Budget

referral_id.description: Optional alr_... ID returned by match_alpinelead_capability.
referral_id.title: Referral Id

name: run_sales_mission
title: Start AlpineLead Sales Agent mission
